llmnav-catalog/1 repository=workduck catalog=workduck.secret-vault
Read semantic cards before opening source. Resolve current paths and signatures with llmnav query or show.

@workduck.secret-vault.crypto
role Validate versioned encrypted secret-vault envelopes at the renderer persistence boundary.
owns secret-vault envelope shape, encrypted vault format constants
excludes plaintext vault access, native session lifecycle, password crypto
invariant Renderer code may validate and persist encrypted envelopes but cannot encrypt or decrypt vault plaintext.

@workduck.secret-vault.crypto-native
role Bind secret-vault envelopes to native password crypto with versioned associated data and closed result errors.
owns native secret-vault encryption, vault envelope conversion, vault crypto error mapping
excludes vault persistence, password interface
invariant Passwords and encryption plaintext remain zeroized, and decrypted plaintext is available only to native callers after authenticated envelope validation succeeds.
